name: NIIT Learning Systems Limited
summary: NIIT Learning Systems Limited provides managed training services in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. Its managed training services include custom content and curriculum design, learning administration and delivery, strategic sourcing, learning technology, and learning and development (L&D) consulting services. The company also offers digital transformation and IT training, immersive learning, customer education, talent pipeline as a service, DE&I training, as well as leadership and professional development training services.The company was formerly known as Mindchampion Learning Systems Limited and changed its name to NIIT Learning Systems Limited in January 2022.
